messages:
Aisha (Sales): Hey team — MediPro (govt healthcare POC) needs SOC2 report excerpt + signed pen-test letter for procurement. Deadline Wed EOD. Also asking if Dedicated reserved capacity reduces price and whether we can allow their external pen test against staging IPs. Any blockers?

Tom (AE): Noted. They specifically want a signed letter on company letterhead that authorizes testing. Can we provide a templated pen-test attestation?

Jorge (Security): We can provide an authorization/attestation letter. We don’t sign third-party reports, but we can sign to authorize scoped testing on our staging or Dedicated POC env. Need: customer IP ranges, test windows, AUP signed, and proof of insurance. SOC2 excerpt is shareable under NDA — I can generate a presigned ZIP.

Raj (Solutions): Pricing note: Dedicated with a monthly commit drops unit cost — we can show committed vs on-demand delta. Need expected QPS/peak for accurate quote. MediPro gave roughs: baseline ~2 rps, peak ~10 rps. Is that enough to draft a Dedicated pricing addendum?

Lena (Eng-ML): For an external pen test against Dedicated/staging we must: whitelist scanner IPs, schedule a maintenance window (to avoid autoscale and false positives), and create an ephemeral account for authenticated scans. Also clarify allowed test vectors (no upstream DB/infra escalation). @Jorge what’s permitted?

Jorge (Security): No active exploitation against production. For staging/dedicated POC we can permit limited active tests if in scope and approved. Authenticated scans OK with ephemeral creds. We require: signed AUP, test plan, and insurer certificate. I’ll attach a short template for the pen-test authorization letter below.

Tom (AE): I’ll ask MediPro for the scope doc and insurer cert. They said NDA is in place already. I’ll confirm and loop back.

Jorge (Security): Pen-test authorization template:
```text
Redwood Inference — Pen Test Authorization

Customer: MediPro
Scope: <staging IP ranges / hostnames>
Window: <date/time UTC>
Allowed testing: vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, limited active testing as agreed
Prohibitions: exploit chaining against infra components, social engineering, attacks on third-party services
Signatory: Redwood Security Lead (name on letterhead)
Notes: Testing subject to AUP and proof of insurance on file.
```

evidence-bot: presigned link generated: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/proofpacks/medipro-soc2-excerpt-2026-03-18.zip (expires in 7 days) :lock:

Aisha (Sales): Great — Tom will collect scope + insurer cert, Jorge will prepare the signed letter, Raj/Lena pls confirm staging IP list and pricing addendum by EOD so we can hit Wed. :pray:
